decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO33 to GPIO47 for ESP32-S3 compatibility does not change the already selected ESP32-S3 controller family.
The source changes only the SPI MOSI assignment; the boost-enable assignment remains GPIO5 and its control behavior is unchanged.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not alter the DCDC1 rail voltage, current rating, stability, or powered loads.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the standalone USB supply, source-selection behavior, regulator, or powered rail.
The source changes SPI MOSI to GPIO47, not the LED data GPIO13, LED supply, level shifting, or standby power control.
The sensor board's connector-fanout role remains unchanged; the source does not specify any connector or sensor-interface change.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not affect the charge-status LED chain, GPIO13, or the external CHGLED interface.
The source does not change battery-protection circuitry, thresholds, controller, or protection components.
The SPI MOSI reassignment does not alter the NTC terminal, connector, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The source does not alter the AXP2101 power path, battery input range, normal power source, or load coverage.
Correcting one ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment does not change the separate-board architecture, board count, or board list.
